div.h3: Test server actions on live builds
div.p: Live builds block creating or editing server actions, crons, automations and fields, and importing modules, unless the request comes from a trusted IP. Add your public IP here to unlock it on every live build until midnight (Argentina time).
div.div: Before you continue: those features run Python code on the build server. Anyone who shares your public IP (same office network, VPN, mobile carrier) gets the same access until the list is cleared.

form.label: Your public IP
form.div: The field shows the IP the runbot sees for you, when it can detect it. To check it, open ifconfig.me from the same network. If your network uses IPv4 and IPv6, add both.
